comment: Independent steal.c witness: a human Valkyrie wears a wished-for helm of telepathy, summons a water nymph, drops everything else and wakes it with a tin whistle. The nymph charms the helm off her, so remove_worn_item() runs Helmet_off(), whose HELM_OF_TELEPATHY arm calls see_monsters(). The port plans each monster move on a copy of the game before playing it; Helmet_off() must pass that plan's silent redraw to see_monsters(), which otherwise refuses to run on a copy.
